individual-data-points.explanation: These are spatial heatmap overlays of continuous deconvolution scores on tissue images; heatmaps are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Spatial deconvolution heatmap plots show color-coded scores per spot, not error bars or box/whisker elements.

individual-data-points.explanation: Box plots inherently display the data distribution and are exempt; the panel additionally shows individual sample points overlaid on the boxes.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile
error-bars-defined.explanation: The caption explicitly defines the box plot elements (quartiles, median, min and max values) for each group and cell population shown.

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment score line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The enrichment plots show a running enrichment score curve with no error bars.

individual-data-points.explanation: The bar graph of log2 fold-change values per gene summarizes a differential expression comparison but does not show the underlying individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The bar graph displays single log2 fold-change values per gene with no error bars drawn.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a quantitative plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel E is a set of micrographs (H&E/IHC images), not a plot, so error bar definition does not apply.
